children: Beneficient announced the planned Q4 2026 launch of AltLens, an alternative asset portfolio analytics and risk platform for family offices and small institutional investors.
Plans to launch AltLens in the fourth quarter of calendar year 2026 to serve family offices and small institutions.
AltLens maps positions to private-market risk segments and uses historical private-fund returns for risk metrics.
Platform will calculate volatility, beta, value-at-risk, correlation, concentration and provide dashboards and reports.
Includes historical and hypothetical stress tests (e.g., 2008-09, 2000-03, 2021-22 scenarios) and custom shocks.
AltLens is part of a broader suite including AltSignal (AI diligence) and AltDeal (acquisition analysis) under Beneficient’s tech platform.

title: Beneficient to launch AltLens analytics and risk platform for family offices in Q4 2026
